articles.summary: LITTLE ELM, Texas – Retractable Technologies, Inc. (“Retractable”) (NYSE American: RVP) announces its support for Senator Marsha Blackburn’s ONSHORE Manufacturing Act, legislation aimed at strengthening domestic production of critical medical supplies. The legislation would provide tax incentives for U.S. manufacturing, including investments in advanced manufacturing equipment and facility modernization. “The ONSHORE Manufacturing Act is the […]
articles.title: Retractable Technologies, Inc. Supports Senator Blackburn’s ONSHORE Manufacturing Act
